summary:
Reconciled `C:/Users/Taka/Desktop/fvtt/Alien-RPG Translation Project/PROJECT.md` against the Phase 0 artifacts (`7-其他内容/DO-NOT-TRANSLATE.json` + the 8 findings JSONs in `7-其他内容/findings/2026-08-29-phase0/`) and appended the Phase 0 round to §8. Nine targeted edits, each asserted unique before substitution; all 20 markdown tables re-validated; §1.3 and §1.4 untouched (byte-verified). WHAT WAS STALE AND IS NOW FIXED 1. **T-FROZEN counts were wrong in TWO places, differently.** §3.4 said "11 RollTable / 2 folders / PACK MULE+TAKE CONTROL"; §1.2 said "10 RollTable / 3 folders / Pack Mule+Take Control". The file says rolltable_names=11, folder_names=3, item_names=6. Both places now point at the register instead of listing; only the three numbers that were actually wrong are kept inline, each marked 以文件为准. Added the two new sections (`macro_commands`, `name_substring_tests`) and the prefix-filter constraint as notes under the §3.4 table. 2. **§1.2 claimed the register is generated by `qa/build_register.py` and that `cite()` failure fails the build.** Refuted — the file's own `_generator_status` says the generator no longer reproduces it and re-running DELETES C1–C9, both `gate_tests` blocks and `rows_with_nonstandard_split` (which `scan_crit_lockstep.py` reads to avoid a false positive). This was the single most dangerous stale line in the document; it now carries a do-not-run warning. 3. **§1.2's crit-injury paragraph described ONE switch.** Replaced with a 3-row table re-derived from `actor.mjs`: `switch(testArray[3])` at :1902 drives cFatal (default → false, silent); `switch(testArray[5])` at :1923 drives healTime (default → 0, silent); the bare `Shift` lives in an `if` chain at :1888-1894 BEFORE both switches and does not fall to a default — it drops into the `[[NdM]]` regex where `.match()` returns null and `null[1]` throws an uncaught TypeError. Also corrected the "healTime 恒为 0" attribution: classic mode is caused by the half-translated cn.json (translation can fix it), Evolved is an upstream defect that is 0 in English too. Added a pointer to the three other branches (`synthetic`/`creature`, `spacecraft`) with the different splitter `/[:] |
/gi` and no `
` normalisation. 4. **§8 Phase 0 entry appended** (append-only respected — the earlier 2026-08-29 · Phase 0 entry is untouched): what was built, the three verifiers' refutation/miss counts, the full bidirectional gate-proof matrix, the seven corruptions that passed both gates and why, and four new methodology conclusions. 5. **§2 / §6 / header** now say Phase 0 is complete. No release invented — 0 commit / 0 tag / `compendium/cn` empty is stated explicitly. Our module versions still appear in exactly two places (header line 8 + §2 matrix); no third place gained one. 6. **§7.2 rewritten** as arrived / can't-mine-yet / genuinely-missing. Items 1-6 arrived and are mined except the Blu-ray VobSub bitmaps, which are recorded as an OPEN item with a measured scale and an explicitly-labelled cost estimate — not as a completed source.

open_issues: §1.4's level-3 row still states Alien: Isolation as '16.3 万键 / 675 万字'. That is the UN-DEDUPLICATED figure — I re-verified by md5 that the tree is 768 paths / 64 unique files, so the real scale is ~13,565 unique keys and the circulating number is 12x inflated. I did NOT edit it because you told me §1.4 is owner-settled. The corrected measurement and the 12x warning are now in §7.2 instead. The owner should decide whether §1.4's row gets the same correction — right now the two sections disagree.

CITATION DRIFT IN THE NEW REGISTER BLOCK: 4 of the 6 file:line citations in `crit_parse_lockstep.other_branches` land on the wrong line, three of them on COMMENTED-OUT code. Re-derived: synthetic/creature branch strip is actor.mjs:2098 (register says 2100 = a comment) and its split is :2101 (register says 1882 = the commented-out V13 line); spacecraft strip is :2133 (register says 2132 = a comment) and its split is :2134 (register says 2101, which is the OTHER branch's split). verify-register-2.json's verdict claims 'every file:line in ... crit_parse_lockstep was independently re-derived by grep; all landed on the correct line' — that claim does not hold for the block that same pass added. build_register.py's cite() passed because the needle text appears inside the comments. I kept these numbers OUT of PROJECT.md, but the register itself should be patched.

HIGHEST RESIDUAL RISK (now flagged in §1.2 and §8, but not fixed): `4-常用脚本/qa/build_register.py` no longer reproduces DO-NOT-TRANSLATE.json. Running it deletes C1-C9, both gate_tests blocks, and rows_with_nonstandard_split — the last of which scan_crit_lockstep.py reads to avoid failing a faithful translation. The generator needs to be brought back in sync before anyone touches it.
§5 SOP is still empty while §1 now says Phase 0 is complete. I flagged it in-doc as the first thing to do before Phase 1 rather than inventing SOP content.

Module 1's release workflow has no 'something to ship' gate (modules 2 and 3 do). In its current skeleton state it would pass every existing check and cut a release containing a 3-byte `{}` lang file and an empty compendium/cn. Noted in §2 and §8; not fixed.

The glossary on disk is now v1.0 / 404 terms, superseding the v0.2 / 346 terms the Phase 0 round produced. §1.4's list of specific term changes (Weyland-Yutani -> 韦兰德-汤谷公司 etc.) was written against the earlier state and should be re-checked against v1.0 by whoever owns the glossary — I did not touch §1.4.

§3.2 transcribes the upstream version `1.0.2` into prose ('1.0.2 可能被无声替换'). It is an upstream version in a hazard note, not one of our module versions, so it does not violate the two-places rule — but it will drift the next time upstream ships. Left as-is; worth a pointer at §2 if you want it airtight.
